info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Surges-v5-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Surge Pricing API provides real-time information on surge pricing for rideshare services. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve data regarding surge conditions, including the specific areas and times where surge pricing is in effect. Typical consumers of this API include rideshare applications and analytics platforms seeking to optimize driver and passenger experiences. By integrating this API, businesses can stay informed about pricing fluctuations, helping them make strategic decisions related to user engagement and fleet management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current surge pricing information for available rides in a specified area. It is useful for understanding dynamic pricing changes based on demand and supply conditions.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving surge ride information. This endpoint allows users to obtain surge pricing details and may require specific parameters to be set based on the requested ride.

200.description: The request was successful and the surge pricing information is returned.
